title: Bandhana
desc: Harish, a doctor, falls in love with Nandini, his student. However, he slips into depression when he confesses his feelings for her and learns that she is marrying her childhood friend, Balu.

title: Shruthi
desc: Four friends aspiring to be musicians cross paths with a woman who is searching for her lover. They see an opportunity to help each other and soon form a partnership.

title: Roshagara
desc: A vigilante constantly blackmails a corrupt businessman. His hidden motive is soon revealed when he kidnaps the businessman's daughter upon her arrival in the country.

title: Vardhana
desc: A man masquerades as a gangster to impress a girl he wants to marry. However, complications arise when he is entangled in a murder case.
A 400-year-old island mysteriously disappears, and two friends set out to investigate this phenomenon. However, they uncover shocking truths about the disappearance when they consult some socialites.
